pages.text: Oftentimes found attached to or hidden in Risus related ruins, Laughing Stalks are the primary method through which the Coalification is spread. They can be harvested and when fed an Organic Matter, they will start spreading the special biome.

pages.title: Coalification
pages.text: Coalification refers to the process where the biome around turns darker and has a negligible cognitohazard effect, where anyone inside will see the sky as dark and red. Additionally, Risus Wisps will regularly appear, which are completely harmless and simply an observable version of the souls/minds present within the Risus. They can also be found congregating within Depth Vases.
